acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

alkylation_reagent.evidence: The following search parameters were used: Oxidation on methionine, phosphorylation on serine, threonine, and tyrosine, deamidation on asparagine and glutamine, iodoacetamide derivative on cysteine, beta-methylthiolation on cysteine, biotinylation on lysine, ubiquitinylation residue on lysine, ubiquitination on lysine, pyro-glu from q on peptide N-terminal glutamine, acetylation on protein N-Terminus were set as variable modifications.

cleavage_agent.evidence: All samples were sourced from transgenic plants either grown on N-rich medium or N-depleted medium and extracted using appropriate buffers, trypsin digested and analyzed by mass spectrometry.

labeling.evidence: inferred: Protein areas have been computed in IMP-apQuant (Doblmann J. et al, J Proteome Res 2019, 18(1):535-41) by summing up unique and razor peptides. Resulting protein areas were normalized using iBAQ (Schwanhäusser B. et al., Nature 2011, 473(7347):337−42) and sum normalization was applied for normalization between samples.
